description.zh:
跨地域备份总开关（数据备份+日志备份），取值：
* **0**：关闭
* **1**：开启

>开启跨地域备份时，必须传入目的地域ID。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-region backup feature on the instance. This parameter specifies whether you can back up data and logs. Valid values:

*   **0**: disables the feature.
*   **1:** enables the feature.

> Before you enable the cross-region backup feature, you must configure the CrossBackupRegion parameter.

description.zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region in which the cross-region backup files of the instance are stored.

description.zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。当前唯一取值：**1**，表示每个备份都保存。
description.en: The policy that is used to save the cross-region backup files of the instance. Set the value to **1**. The value 1 specifies that all cross-region backup files are saved.

description.zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
* **0**：关闭
* **1**：开启

>跨地域备份总开关开启时，才能设置日志开关。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-region log backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

*   **0**: disables the feature.
*   **1:** enables the feature.

> You can enable the cross-region log backup feature only when the cross-region backup feature is enabled.

description.zh: 源实例地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the source instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。当前唯一取值：**1**，表示按时长保留。
description.en: The policy that is used to retain the cross-region backup files of the instance. Set the value to 1. The value **1** specifies that the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained based on the specified retention period.

description.zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：**7~1825**。
description.en: The number of days for which the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained. Valid values: **7 to 1825**.
